title: Commemoration Ceremony for the 40th Day of "Iran's Martyred Leader" to Be Held in Tehran, Qom, and Mashhad by the Supreme Leader
text:
Commemoration Ceremony for the 40th Day of "Iran's Martyred Leader" to Be Held in Tehran, Qom, and Mashhad by the Supreme Leader"

"**The Office of the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution** has issued an announcement regarding the holding of memorial services for the martyred leader, His Holiness Grand Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Hosseini Khamenei, on the occasion of the 40th day of his funeral and burial."

"---"

"**Full text of the announcement from the Office of the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution:**"

"*In the Name of God*"

"Concurrent with the 40th day of the historic funeral and burial of the sacred body of Iran's martyred leader, a commemorative ceremony for that greatly esteemed leader and his family will be held by His Holiness Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in Tehran, Qom, and Mashhad."

"The memorial services for the martyred leader, His Holiness Grand Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Hosseini Khamenei, will be held as follows:"

"- **Tehran:** Tuesday, *Mordad 27* (August 18, 2026), from 17:00 to 19:00, at the prayer hall (*Shabestan*) of the Imam Khomeini Grand Prayer Grounds (*Mosalla*)."

"- **Qom:** Wednesday, *Mordad 28* (August 19, 2026), after the Maghrib and Isha (evening and night) prayers, at the Holy Shrine of Hazrat Fatemeh Masoumeh (peace be upon her)."

"- **Mashhad:** Thursday, *Mordad 29* (August 20, 2026), coinciding with the eve of the martyrdom anniversary of Imam Hassan Askari (peace be upon him), after the Maghrib and Isha prayers, at the Holy Razavi Shrine (the shrine of Imam Reza)."

"The grateful people of Iran are invited to participate in the memorial service for the martyred leader."

"The passionate and widespread presence of the general public and the devotees of the two leaders (*Imams*) of the Revolution in the 40th-day commemoration of the martyred leader will serve as a renewed pledge of allegiance to the current Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution and a renewed emphasis on continuing the path of Iran's martyred leader.
